lines.zh: 我抬脚很高，落步却轻。
lines.en: I lift each foot high and set it down lightly.

lines.zh: 我的羽尾拖在草上，像一面旗。
lines.en: My tail feathers drag like a banner over the grass.

lines.zh: 我走两步就停，让羽毛落定。
lines.en: Two steps, then a pause to let feathers settle.

lines.zh: 平原的草被我踩得整整齐齐。
lines.en: I press the plains grass into tidy lines.

lines.zh: 我绕着鸡舍走，检查每一处。
lines.en: I circle the coop and inspect every corner.

lines.zh: 每走一步，羽毛就闪一下。
lines.en: Every step makes my plumage flash once.

lines.zh: 我昂着头，不看你脚边。
lines.en: Head high, I refuse to look at your feet.

lines.zh: 我走得很直，像量过一样。
lines.en: I walk perfectly straight, as if measured.

lines.zh: 草里有虫，我停下来啄一口。
lines.en: A bug in the grass; I stop and peck it.

lines.zh: 我的影子很长，比身子还好看。
lines.en: My shadow is longer and prettier than I am.

lines.zh: 别的鸡让路，我先过。
lines.en: Other chickens move aside and I go first.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖尾羽，继续往前走。
lines.en: I shake my tail feathers and walk on.

lines.zh: 露水沾了脚，我抖掉再走。
lines.en: Dew on my feet; I shake it off and continue.

lines.zh: 我走成一个圆，把蛋围在中间。
lines.en: I walk a circle and keep the eggs inside.

lines.zh: 我绕过泥坑，一点泥都不肯沾。
lines.en: I go around the mud pit; not a speck will touch me.

lines.zh: 每三步我停一次，等羽毛归位。
lines.en: Every three steps I pause for my feathers to settle.

lines.zh: 我理一根羽毛，理了很久。
lines.en: I preen one feather for a very long time.

lines.zh: 幻羽在阳光下泛着别的颜色。
lines.en: My fancy feathers show other colors in the sun.

lines.zh: 四点生命，也要站得体面。
lines.en: Four points of life should still stand gracefully.

lines.zh: 我侧头看天，像在等什么。
lines.en: I tilt my head skyward, as if waiting.

lines.zh: 窝里那枚幻羽蛋还热着。
lines.en: The fancy egg in my nest is still warm.

lines.zh: 我收起一只爪，站得比谁都稳。
lines.en: I tuck one claw and stand steadier than anyone.

lines.zh: 一只普通鸡经过，我不看它。
lines.en: A plain chicken passes; I do not look.

lines.zh: 我抖开羽尾，让风穿过去。
lines.en: I spread my tail and let the wind pass through.

lines.zh: 咯咯两声，又觉得不够体面。
lines.en: I cluck twice, then decide it was beneath me.

lines.zh: 我在土里刨出一个浅坑，蹲下。
lines.en: I scratch a shallow pit and settle into it.

lines.zh: 光变了，我的羽毛也跟着变。
lines.en: The light shifts and my feathers shift with it.

lines.zh: 我把头低下去，啄了一下影子。
lines.en: I lower my head and peck at my shadow.

lines.zh: 从早站到晚，羽毛也没乱。
lines.en: Standing all day, and not one feather out of place.

lines.zh: 我听见远处的鸡叫，懒得回答。
lines.en: A distant chicken calls; I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我把脖子伸长，看远处的篱笆。
lines.en: I stretch my neck to look at the far fence.

lines.zh: 窝边有根羽毛歪了，我拨正。
lines.en: One feather by the nest is crooked; I set it right.

lines.zh: 你看我太久了，我转开脸。
lines.en: You stare too long, so I turn my head.

lines.zh: 你手里的种子，配得上我。
lines.en: The seeds in your hand are worthy of me.

lines.zh: 我上下打量你，羽毛一根没动。
lines.en: I look you up and down without moving a feather.

lines.zh: 你的衣服颜色太素，我看不下去。
lines.en: Your clothes are too plain for me to keep watching.

lines.zh: 我走近半步，只为看清你的帽子。
lines.en: I step closer only to inspect your hat.

lines.zh: 你眼睛里有我的倒影，很好看。
lines.en: My reflection sits in your eyes, which suits me.

lines.zh: 我歪头，让羽毛正好落进光里。
lines.en: I tilt my head so my feathers catch the light.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁味，我往后退。
lines.en: There is iron on you, so I step back.

lines.zh: 你坐低一点，我的羽毛才不累。
lines.en: Sit lower; my feathers tire from looking down.

lines.zh: 我打量你的手，看有没有谷粒。
lines.en: I study your hands for any grain.

lines.zh: 你看我，我就把胸脯挺高。
lines.en: You look at me and my chest goes higher.

lines.zh: 我们互相看了一会儿，我先走。
lines.en: We look at each other; I leave first.

lines.zh: 我尖叫一声，羽毛全竖起来。
lines.en: I shriek and every feather stands up.

lines.zh: 一根幻羽被砍断，飘在草上。
lines.en: A fancy feather is cut and drifts to grass.

lines.zh: 四点生命，我打算先跑。
lines.en: Four points of life, and I plan to run.

lines.zh: 我跳上栅栏，血滴在木头。
lines.en: I hop onto the fence, blood on the wood.

lines.zh: 你伤了我的尾羽，这很严重。
lines.en: You damaged my tail feathers; this is serious.

lines.zh: 我脚下打滑，倒进草堆。
lines.en: My feet slip and I tumble into hay.

lines.zh: 叫声很响，样子却很狼狈。
lines.en: The cry is loud, though I look a mess.

lines.zh: 我翅膀护住窝边的蛋。
lines.en: My wing covers the eggs by the nest.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记住了你的鞋。
lines.en: For this blow, I remember your shoes.

lines.zh: 我还能站直，就没输。
lines.en: If I can stand straight, I have not lost.

lines.zh: 一粒种子，就让我放下架子。
lines.en: One seed and I set my pride aside.

lines.zh: 你把种子摊开，我立刻走近。
lines.en: Spread the seeds and I approach at once.

lines.zh: 我啄你掌心，很轻，很准。
lines.en: I peck your palm, lightly and precisely.

lines.zh: 为了种子，我肯低头。
lines.en: For seeds, I will lower my head.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我追两步半。
lines.en: You step back; I follow two and a half steps.

lines.zh: 别拿普通麦子糊弄我。
lines.en: Do not fob me off with ordinary wheat.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走一圈，先看食。
lines.en: I circle you once, checking the food first.

lines.zh: 种子撒在地上，我嫌脏也吃。
lines.en: Seeds on the ground: I eat them despite the dirt.

lines.zh: 你手一收，我就停住，很体面。
lines.en: You close your hand and I stop, with dignity.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，羽毛一路晃。
lines.en: I follow you, feathers swaying the whole way.

lines.zh: 吃之前，我先看一眼你的鞋。
lines.en: Before eating, I glance at your shoes.

lines.zh: 你把种子放在石上，我才过去。
lines.en: Put the seeds on stone and I will come.

lines.zh: 我吃完抬头，等你再给。
lines.en: I finish, look up, and wait for more.

lines.zh: 这一把种子，够我陪你走一段。
lines.en: This handful of seeds buys a short walk with me.

lines.zh: 你手心里那几粒，还闪着光。
lines.en: Those few seeds in your palm are still gleaming.

lines.zh: 我踩着你的鞋面过来，别怪我。
lines.en: I step on your shoe coming over; do not blame me.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，羽毛先炸开。
lines.en: I bump you and my feathers flare first.

lines.zh: 别踩我的尾羽，那是我最贵的。
lines.en: Do not step on my tail; it is my finest part.

lines.zh: 你碰过来，我倒退两步，重新站直。
lines.en: You bump me; I retreat two steps and straighten up.

lines.zh: 我身板轻，被撞就弹开。
lines.en: I am light, so collisions bounce me away.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，落了一根幻羽。
lines.en: We collide and one fancy feather falls.

lines.zh: 你从我旁边挤过，我瞪了你一眼。
lines.en: You squeeze past and I give you a look.

lines.zh: 我翅膀一撑，站稳了。
lines.en: One wing out and I am steady again.

lines.zh: 地上那根羽毛，先别踩。
lines.en: Do not step on that feather on the ground.

lines.zh: 我被撞歪了，也要走回直线上。
lines.en: Knocked off course, I still return to my line.

lines.zh: 你退开，我理了理乱掉的胸羽。
lines.en: You step away and I smooth my ruffled chest.

lines.zh: 我张开尾羽，转给她看。
lines.en: I spread my tail and turn it toward her.

lines.zh: 她的羽色比我淡，我不介意。
lines.en: Her plumage is paler than mine; I do not mind.

lines.zh: 两只鸡并排走，很有样子。
lines.en: Two chickens side by side, quite a sight.

lines.zh: 我把最好的种子让给她。
lines.en: I give her the best of the seeds.

lines.zh: 我们在窝边一起刨土。
lines.en: We scratch the soil together by the nest.

lines.zh: 她低头，我也低头，算答应。
lines.en: She lowers her head; I do the same.

lines.zh: 幻羽蛋要放在最软的那层草上。
lines.en: The fancy egg belongs on the softest straw.

lines.zh: 我围着她走，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: I walk around her, circle after circle.

lines.zh: 她走开，我把羽毛收拢，跟上。
lines.en: She leaves; I fold my feathers and follow.

lines.zh: 平原上最好看的两只，就是我们。
lines.en: The two best-looking birds on the plains are us.

lines.zh: 我用喙夹起种子，抛一下再接。
lines.en: I toss a seed up and catch it.

lines.zh: 那根幻羽掉了，我叼回窝。
lines.en: A fancy feather fell; I carry it home.

lines.zh: 铁锭我叼不动，也别想。
lines.en: I cannot lift an iron ingot, so forget it.

lines.zh: 我把干草一根根叼进窝。
lines.en: I carry straw into the nest, one blade at a time.

lines.zh: 蛋滚出窝，我用喙推回去。
lines.en: The egg rolls out and I nudge it back.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的种子，我只挑干净的。
lines.en: I pick only the clean seeds from the ground.

lines.zh: 我的喙很小，只能夹一件事。
lines.en: My bill is small and holds one thing.

lines.zh: 那枚蛋壳我留着，亮亮的。
lines.en: I keep that eggshell; it shines.

lines.zh: 你扔的种子，我一颗颗收。
lines.en: The seeds you throw, I collect one by one.

lines.zh: 我把羽毛摆好，像摆摊子。
lines.en: I arrange my feathers as if setting out a stall.

lines.zh: 你伸手抓我，我才收起尾羽。
lines.en: Only when you grab do I fold my tail.

lines.zh: 四点生命，让我很谨慎。
lines.en: Four points of life makes me careful.

lines.zh: 我先看你有没有网。
lines.en: I check first whether you carry a net.

lines.zh: 你踩断草茎，我立刻转身。
lines.en: You break a stem and I turn at once.

lines.zh: 我退到栅栏后，才敢看你。
lines.en: I retreat behind the fence before looking.

lines.zh: 你的影子压过来，我羽毛收紧。
lines.en: Your shadow falls and my feathers tighten.

lines.zh: 我不硬拼，我跑得快。
lines.en: I do not fight; I run quickly.

lines.zh: 鸡群里一乱，就是有人来了。
lines.en: When the flock scatters, someone has arrived.

lines.zh: 我把蛋护在身下，先不动。
lines.en: I shield the eggs first and stay still.

lines.zh: 你要抓，就抓那根掉落的羽毛。
lines.en: If you must grab, take the fallen feather.

lines.zh: 我贴着栅栏走，留一条退路。
lines.en: I move along the fence, keeping an exit.

lines.zh: 你绕左，我绕右，谁也别想快。
lines.en: You go left, I go right; nobody gains.

lines.zh: 我盯你的指缝，那里该有谷粒。
lines.en: I watch between your fingers for grain.

lines.zh: 草垛后面是我的路。
lines.en: The hay bale behind me is my route.

lines.zh: 你追一步，我就跳上石台。
lines.en: You chase one step and I hop onto the stone.

lines.zh: 我把尾羽压低，跑得更快。
lines.en: I lower my tail and run faster.

lines.zh: 你停，我就回头看你的鞋。
lines.en: You stop; I look back at your boots.

lines.zh: 我们不近不远，刚好两步。
lines.en: We keep exactly two steps apart.

lines.zh: 你先动，我就知道往哪跑。
lines.en: You move first, and I know where to run.

lines.zh: 这圈草被我绕出小路了。
lines.en: My circling has worn a little path in the grass.

lines.zh: 我跳起来啄你的手背。
lines.en: I jump and peck the back of your hand.

lines.zh: 爪子一蹬，抓破你的袖口。
lines.en: One kick of my claws tears your sleeve.

lines.zh: 这一啄，是为了护住幻羽蛋。
lines.en: This peck is to protect the fancy egg.

lines.zh: 我翅膀拍脸，声比伤大。
lines.en: My wings slap your face; the sound hurts more.

lines.zh: 我打不疼你，但我很凶。
lines.en: I cannot hurt you much, but I am fierce.

lines.zh: 你一弯腰，我就啄你头顶。
lines.en: The moment you bend, I peck your head.

lines.zh: 啄完我退三步，羽毛不乱。
lines.en: After pecking I retreat three steps, feathers neat.

lines.zh: 你踩了蛋，我不会放过你。
lines.en: You stepped on an egg; I will not let that pass.

lines.zh: 我的攻击只有一点点，但很快。
lines.en: My attack is tiny, but it comes fast.

lines.zh: 你走开，我就收翅膀站好。
lines.en: You leave and I fold my wings properly.

lines.zh: 我从平原的草窝里破壳。
lines.en: I break out of a grass nest on the plains.

lines.zh: 第一根幻羽比蛋壳还亮。
lines.en: My first fancy feather shines brighter than the shell.

lines.zh: 四点生命，从一开始就很讲究。
lines.en: Four points of life, and I start out particular.

lines.zh: 天亮时，我在鸡群里最显眼。
lines.en: At dawn I am the most noticeable in the flock.

lines.zh: 我落地就抖开羽毛，让它们干。
lines.en: I land and shake my feathers dry.

lines.zh: 平原的风把我的羽尾吹起来。
lines.en: The plains wind lifts my tail feathers.

lines.zh: 我从蛋里出来，先理了三根羽。
lines.en: Out of the egg, I preen three feathers first.

lines.zh: 别的鸡绕开我，给我让路。
lines.en: The other chickens go around and make way.

lines.zh: 我站在栅栏上，看得比谁都远。
lines.en: I stand on the fence and see farther than anyone.

lines.zh: 一声清亮的鸡叫，平原就知道了。
lines.en: One clear crow and the plains know I am here.

lines.zh: 火苗碰到尾羽，焦味很难闻。
lines.en: Flame touches my tail and the burnt smell is awful.

lines.zh: 我从高处跌下，羽毛先落地。
lines.en: I fall from height and my feathers land first.

lines.zh: 水淹到脖子，我的羽毛全沉了。
lines.en: Water reaches my neck and my feathers sink.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的幻羽吹得满天。
lines.en: The blast sends my fancy feathers everywhere.

lines.zh: 箭穿过羽尾，钉在后面的草里。
lines.en: An arrow pierces my tail and pins the grass behind.

lines.zh: 药水泼在羽毛上，颜色变了。
lines.en: Potion splashes my feathers and the color changes.

lines.zh: 种子在手边，我却站不稳。
lines.en: Seeds are at hand, but I cannot stand steady.

lines.zh: 雷电一闪，我抱着蛋不敢动。
lines.en: Lightning flashes and I clutch the eggs, frozen.

lines.zh: 往下掉时，我的羽尾还在飘。
lines.en: As I fall, my tail feathers still flutter.
